user.title: Sign in to Carlink
user.description: Enter your Carlink service credentials, not your Home Assistant login. Only the first vehicle on the account is supported.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Carlink again
reauth_confirm.description: Use the same Carlink account and vehicle. Previously submitted commands will not be retried.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Carlink. Try again.
error.no_assets: No vehicles were found in this Carlink account.
error.identity_mismatch: The account or first vehicle differs from the configured identity. Existing credentials have not been changed.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This Carlink account is already configured.

platform_setup_failed.message: Carlink platforms could not be loaded. Reload the integration to retry.

platform_cleanup_failed.message: Carlink platforms could not be unloaded. Controls are disabled; restart Home Assistant before retrying.

identity_mismatch.message: The account or first vehicle has changed. Restore the originally configured vehicle/account, or remove and configure the integration again to bind a different vehicle. No commands were submitted.

invalid_action.message: This action is not supported. No command was submitted.

busy.message: Another command is still running. This new command was not submitted.

closed.message: The Carlink connection is closing. No command was submitted.

command_failed.message: Carlink reported that the command failed.

unknown_outcome.message: The command outcome could not be confirmed. It may have executed. Check the vehicle before trying again.

auth_failed.message: Authentication failed. Sign in again. Any command already submitted could not be confirmed and will not be retried.

no_assets.message: No vehicles were found in this Carlink account.
